name: Quick AI
tagline: Ask Claude Code, Codex or Cursor about what you are working on, from any window.

sections.heading: Ask about what is in front of you
sections.body: Press Cmd+J, or click the sparkles button in the toolbar, to open the Quick AI panel. It sends your question to the Claude Code, Codex or Cursor command-line tool you already use, with your own sign-in, and streams the answer as Markdown.
bullets: Attach the terminal, browser page, folder or branch as context chips, or type @ to add one (Cursor gets the folder and branch)
Pick the provider, model and effort in the footer, which also shows your account
Type / for your Claude commands and skills, or $ for your Codex skills
Start a message with ! to pass a command to the AI exactly as you typed it
Press Return while it replies to queue your next message

sections.heading: A chat for every workspace
sections.body: Each workspace keeps its own chat and reopens it after a relaunch. The Chat tab is one conversation shared by every workspace, working in your home folder or any folder you choose.
bullets: Saved chats are in History: questions, answers and tool summaries, never the attached text. Delete one or all
Up arrow brings back earlier messages
Requests that need your approval are declined
Set transparency, blur, text size and panel size in Settings › Quick AI
